caption: The drawing shows a rectangular wooden chest with short legs and two lower drawers fitted with brass handles. The chest is mainly green with brown edges and legs. The front panel is divided into three sections: two outer rectangles and a central arched section, each decorated with floral motifs in red, yellow, and green, set against a cream background and bordered with red. The left and right front panels each have a line of text at the top in a different color. The right side of the chest features a circular motif containing a star with alternating green and yellow points on a red background. The top surface of the chest is illustrated with a yellow and red flower-like design at its center. The overall style employs colored pencil or watercolor, with careful attention to lines and decorations. The artist’s name, Lorenz Rothkranz, is written in small print at the lower right corner of the drawing. The background of the drawing is a plain, light tan color.
title: Pa. German Dower Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
